tools.name: functions.browser_exec
tools.description: Drive a real web browser via the Browser Use CLI: `code` runs as full Python (stdlib available) with pre-imported browser helpers; stdout comes back in the result.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Python code to execute using the pre-imported browser helpers. Use print(...) for any data you need back.

parameters.name: session
parameters.description: Named isolated browser session — its own daemon and (on cloud backends) own browser, so concurrent tasks don't share tabs. Reuse the same name on every related call; omit for the shared default session.

parameters.name: timeout_s
parameters.description: Max seconds to wait for the code to finish (default 300, max 1800).

tools.name: functions.clarify
tools.description: Ask the user one or more questions when you need a decision, clarification, or feedback before proceeding.

parameters.name: questions
parameters.description: The question(s). Each: question text (options excluded), optional choices (recommended first; omit for free-text), optional multi_select. Responses come back in question order with the question text echoed.

tools.name: functions.computer_use
tools.description: Drive the desktop via cua-driver — screenshots, mouse, keyboard, scroll, drag — on macOS, Windows, and Linux.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Which action to perform. `capture` is free (no side effects). All other actions require approval unless auto-approved. Use `set_value` for select/popup elements and sliders — it selects the matching option directly without opening the native menu (no focus steal).

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Capture mode. `som` (default) is a screenshot with numbered overlays on every interactable element plus the AX tree — best for vision models, lets you click by element index. `vision` is a plain screenshot. `ax` is the accessibility tree only (no image; useful for text-only models).

parameters.name: app
parameters.description: Optional. Limit capture/action to one app (name e.g. 'Safari', or bundle ID). Omitted = frontmost window. app='screen' = composited full-screen grab (image only, no clickable elements); app='desktop' = the OS desktop/shell surface (wallpaper, icons, taskbar) with its elements.

parameters.name: pid
parameters.description: Optional exact process target for action='capture'. Pair with window_id when discovery cannot resolve an X11 app.

parameters.name: window_id
parameters.description: Optional exact native window target for action='capture'. Pair with pid when an external cua-driver list_windows lookup has already identified the window.

parameters.name: element
parameters.description: The 1-based SOM index returned by the last `capture(mode='som')` call. Strongly preferred over raw coordinates.

parameters.name: coordinate
parameters.description: Pixel coordinates [x, y] relative to the captured window screenshot (top-left origin). Only use this if no element index is available.

parameters.name: button
parameters.description: Mouse button. Defaults to left.

parameters.name: modifiers
parameters.description: Modifier keys held during the action.

parameters.name: from_element
parameters.description: Source element index (drag).

parameters.name: to_element
parameters.description: Target element index (drag).

parameters.name: from_coordinate
parameters.description: Source [x,y] (drag; use when no element available).

parameters.name: to_coordinate
parameters.description: Target [x,y] (drag; use when no element available).

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Scroll direction.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: Scroll wheel ticks. Default 3.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: For action='set_value': the value to set on the element. For AXPopUpButton / select dropdowns, pass the option's display label (e.g. 'Blue'). For sliders and other AXValue-settable elements, pass the numeric or string value.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Text to type (respects the current layout).

parameters.name: keys
parameters.description: Key combo, e.g. 'cmd+s', 'ctrl+alt+t', 'return', 'escape', 'tab'. Use '+' to combine.

parameters.name: seconds
parameters.description: Seconds to wait. Max 30.

parameters.name: raise_window
parameters.description: Only for action='focus_app'. If true, brings the window to front (DISRUPTS the user). Default false — input is routed to the app without raising, matching the background co-work model.

parameters.name: delivery_mode
parameters.description: For input actions (click, type, key, drag, scroll). `background` (DEFAULT) delivers without raising the window or stealing focus. `foreground` briefly fronts the window then restores focus — a visible change needing its own approval; use it only when a result's verdict tells you to escalate there. Each result's `verdict` carries the next step; follow it rather than guessing.

parameters.name: bring_to_front
parameters.description: Optional and only valid with delivery_mode='foreground'. Explicitly invokes cua-driver's standalone bring_to_front tool before the input; it is never passed as an input property. This persistent focus change has a separate approval scope. Default false.

parameters.name: capture_after
parameters.description: If true, take a follow-up capture after the action and include it in the response. Saves a round-trip when you need to verify an action's effect.

tools.name: functions.cronjob
tools.description: Manage scheduled cron jobs: action='create' schedules a job from a prompt and/or skills; 'list' inspects jobs; 'update'/'pause'/'resume'/'remove' manage one by job_id; 'run' fires a job immediately in the BACKGROUND.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: One of: create, list, update, pause, resume, remove, run. When action=create, the 'schedule' and 'prompt' fields are REQUIRED.

parameters.name: job_id
parameters.description: Required for update/pause/resume/remove/run

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: For create: the full self-contained prompt (paired with any skills as the task instruction). For run: optional transient context for that single fire (never persisted).

parameters.name: schedule
parameters.description: REQUIRED for create. Schedule forms: recurring interval, explicit one-shot by duration, natural day/time, cron syntax, or absolute one-shot ISO timestamp.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Optional human-friendly name

parameters.name: repeat
parameters.description: Optional repeat count. Omit for defaults (once for one-shot, forever for recurring).

parameters.name: deliver
parameters.description: Where the job's output is POSTED as a one-way message.

parameters.name: skills
parameters.description: Optional ordered skill names loaded before the cron prompt. On update, [] clears.

parameters.name: script
parameters.description: Optional script run each tick; stdout is injected into the agent's prompt as context (with no_agent=True the script IS the job).

parameters.name: monitor
parameters.description: Optional change-detector that gates the agent: an http(s) URL or a script path.

parameters.name: no_agent
parameters.description: True = no LLM: the scheduler runs `script` (required) on schedule and delivers its stdout verbatim.

parameters.name: context_from
parameters.description: Optional job ID(s) whose most recent completed output is injected as context each run.

parameters.name: continuity
parameters.description: True = each run sees the job's own previous output, so it can dedupe and continue where it left off.

parameters.name: enabled_toolsets
parameters.description: Optional toolset names to restrict the job's agent to (e.g. ["web", "terminal"]).

parameters.name: workdir
parameters.description: Optional absolute existing path to run the job from.

parameters.name: attach_to_session
parameters.description: True = the job's delivery is CONTINUABLE — the user can reply and the agent has the brief in context.

tools.name: functions.delegate_task
tools.description: Spawn subagents in isolated contexts; each gets its own conversation, terminal session, and toolset, and only its final summary returns to you.

parameters.name: tasks
parameters.description: What this subagent should accomplish. Be specific and self-contained — it knows nothing of this conversation history.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Default 'spawn'. Live control of running children: 'list' = ids/goals/status/transcripts; 'steer' = queue course-correction text into one child; 'stop' = end one child early.

parameters.name: subagent_id
parameters.description: Target for action='steer'/'stop' (ids from the spawn response or action='list')

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: For action='steer': the course correction, appended to the child's next tool result mid-run. Be directive and specific.

tools.name: functions.execute_code
tools.description: Run Python that calls Hermes tools programmatically. Use when you need 3+ tool calls with logic between them: filtering/reducing large outputs before they enter context, branching, or loops.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Python code to execute. Import tools with `from hermes_tools import web_search, terminal, ...` and print your final result to stdout.

parameters.name: reset
parameters.description: Discard the kernel's persistent state and start fresh before running this code.

tools.name: functions.memory
tools.description: Save durable facts to persistent memory that survive across sessions. Memory is injected into every future turn, so keep entries compact and high-signal.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The action to perform (single-op shape). Omit when using 'operations'.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Which memory store: 'memory' for personal notes, 'user' for user profile.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: The entry content. Required for 'add' and 'replace' (single-op shape). Alias: 'new_text' is also accepted (mirrors old_text).

parameters.name: old_text
parameters.description: REQUIRED for 'replace' and 'remove' (single-op shape): a short unique substring identifying the existing entry to modify. Omit only for 'add'.

parameters.name: new_text
parameters.description: Alias for 'content' (single-op shape).

parameters.name: operations
parameters.description: Batch shape: a list of operations applied atomically against the final char budget.

tools.name: functions.patch
tools.description: Targeted find-and-replace edits in files. Use this instead of sed/awk in terminal.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Edit mode. 'replace' (default): requires path + old_string + new_string. 'patch': requires patch content only.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: File path to edit.

parameters.name: old_string
parameters.description: Exact text to find and replace. Must be unique in the file unless replace_all=true.

parameters.name: new_string
parameters.description: Changed replacement text; it must differ from old_string. Pass empty string '' to delete the matched text.

parameters.name: replace_all
parameters.description: Replace all occurrences instead of requiring a unique match (default: false)

parameters.name: patch
parameters.description: REQUIRED when mode='patch'. V4A format patch content.

tools.name: functions.process
tools.description: Manage background processes started with terminal(background=true). poll: status + new output. log: full output, paged. wait: block until exit or timeout. write vs submit: submit appends Enter; write sends raw bytes, no newline. close: EOF stdin. kill: terminate.

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: From terminal background output; any unique prefix works. Required except for 'list'.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Stdin text for write/submit.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Max seconds for 'wait'.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Log line offset (default: last 200).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max log lines.

tools.name: functions.read_file
tools.description: Read a text file with line numbers and pagination. Use this instead of cat/head/tail in terminal.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the file to read (absolute, relative, or ~/path)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed, default: 1)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of lines to read (default: 2000, max: 2000). Reads are additionally capped at a ~100K-character budget with a next_offset continuation.

tools.name: functions.search_files
tools.description: Search file contents or find files by name. Use this instead of grep/rg/find/ls in terminal.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Regex pattern for content search, or glob pattern (e.g., '*.py') for file search

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: 'content' searches inside file contents, 'files' searches for files by name

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Directory or file to search in (default: current working directory)

parameters.name: file_glob
parameters.description: Filter files by pattern in grep mode (e.g., '*.py' to only search Python files)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 50)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Skip first N results for pagination (default: 0)

parameters.name: output_mode
parameters.description: Output format for grep mode: full matches with line numbers, file paths only, or match counts.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: Number of context lines before and after each match (grep mode only)

tools.name: functions.session_search
tools.description: Search past Hermes sessions (FTS5 over the local session DB), or read/scroll inside one.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search query (discovery shape). Keywords, phrases, or boolean expressions to find in past sessions.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Discovery shape only. Max sessions to return (default 3, max 10).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Discovery shape only. Temporal bias on top of FTS5 ranking.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: Discovery shape only. 'adaptive' (default) fully hydrates the top-ranked result; 'full' returns complete anchored window for every result.

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: Scroll shape. Session to read inside. Use the session_id returned from a prior discovery call.

parameters.name: around_message_id
parameters.description: Scroll shape. Message id to center the window on.

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: Scroll shape only. Messages to return on each side of the anchor.

parameters.name: role_filter
parameters.description: Optional. Comma-separated roles to include.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Optional. Read sessions from another Hermes profile's database (read-only).

parameters.name: operations

parameters.name: category

tools.name: functions.terminal

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: The shell command to execute

parameters.name: background

parameters.name: timeout

parameters.name: workdir

tools.name: multi_tool_use.parallel

tools.name: discord
tools.description:
Read and participate in a Discord server.

Available actions:
  search_members(guild_id, query)  — find members by name prefix
  fetch_messages(channel_id)  — recent messages; optional before/after snowflakes
  create_thread(channel_id, name)  — create a public thread; optional message_id anchor

Use the channel_id from the current conversation context. Use search_members to look up user IDs by name prefix.

parameters.name: guild_id
parameters.description: Discord server (guild) ID.

parameters.name: channel_id
parameters.description: Discord channel ID.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Discord user ID.

parameters.name: role_id
parameters.description: Discord role ID.

parameters.name: message_id
parameters.description: Discord message ID.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Member name prefix to search for (search_members).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: New thread name (create_thread).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max results (default 50). Applies to fetch_messages, search_members.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Snowflake ID for reverse pagination (fetch_messages).

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Snowflake ID for forward pagination (fetch_messages).

parameters.name: auto_archive_duration
parameters.description: Thread archive duration in minutes (create_thread, default 1440).

tools.name: video_analyze
tools.description: Analyze a video from a URL or local file path using a multimodal AI model. Sends the video to a video-capable model (e.g. Gemini) for understanding. Use this for video files — for images, use vision_analyze instead. Supports mp4, webm, mov, avi, mkv, mpeg formats. Note: large videos (>20 MB) may be slow; max ~50 MB.

parameters.name: video_url
parameters.description: Video URL (http/https) or local file path to analyze.

parameters.name: question
parameters.description: Your specific question about the video. The AI will describe what happens in the video and answer your question.
